prompt: Create an ER diagram for a blog platform with Users, Posts, Comments, and Tags. Users have many Posts, Posts have many Comments, Users write Comments, and Posts have many Tags (many-to-many).

assertions.name: valid_json
assertions.description: Output file parses as valid JSON

assertions.name: valid_excalidraw_structure
assertions.description: Has type='excalidraw', version=2, and elements array

assertions.name: bidirectional_bindings
assertions.description: Every arrow binding has a matching boundElements entry on the target shape, and vice versa

assertions.name: all_entities_present
assertions.description: Text elements mention all 4 entities: Users, Posts, Comments, Tags

assertions.name: has_relationship_arrows
assertions.description: Contains arrow elements with arrowhead types set (not all null)

assertions.name: has_crowfoot_notation
assertions.description: At least one arrow uses crowfoot arrowhead types (crowfoot_one, crowfoot_many, crowfoot_one_or_many)

assertions.name: no_overlapping_shapes
assertions.description: No two non-text shape elements occupy the exact same x,y position
